title: Having Issues
text: Having Issues. First, mine came dented. I mean, it was inevitable in my busy household that it would eventually get dented, so I kind of took it in stride. But that wasn't a great start. The whole thing is large. But the trash side is smaller than my pervious can and the recycling side is even smaller. It does have holes in the inner plastic bins so bags glide in and out easily. But a completely full bag in this can is about half full when you pull it out. That is a little frustrating. Also, the bags don't sit very securely inside the inner plastic bin because  the bins are smaller than kitchen trash bags. They just don't sit very well. The foot lever also require quite a lot of force to open the lid. And the lid is ONLY openable by the foot lever. The lid closes flush to the can, so you cannot open it without using the foot lever. It can be propped open.
